definitions.explanation: The combined crime of offering and accepting bribes. Covers both sides of bribery — the person giving the bribe and the official receiving it.

examples.japanese: {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧になった。
examples.english: The bribery case became big news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The mayor is being investigated on suspicion of bribery.

notes:
A compound of {贈|ぞう} (giving) + {収|しゅう} (receiving) + {賄|わい} (bribe). The word covers both ⟦{贈賄|ぞうわい}→贈賄：21598_zouwai⟧ (offering a bribe) and ⟦{収賄|しゅうわい}→収賄：27665_shuuwai⟧ (accepting a bribe) as a single concept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: bribery case/scandal
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧: suspicion of bribery
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}される→起訴する：09863_kisosuru⟧: to be indicted for bribery
- {贈収賄|ぞうしゅうわい}{罪|ざい}: the crime of bribery

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{贈賄|ぞうわい}→贈賄：21598_zouwai⟧: giving a bribe — the crime committed by the bribe-giver
- ⟦{収賄|しゅうわい}→収賄：27665_shuuwai⟧: accepting a bribe — the crime committed by the official
- ⟦{賄賂|わいろ}→賄賂：21571_wairo⟧: bribe — the money or goods exchanged
- ⟦{汚職|おしょく}→汚職：17399_oshoku⟧: corruption — broader term for official misconduct
